title: Add development environment setup (AGENTS.md)
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud development environment instructions for this Shopify theme repository. ## What's included - Documents Shopify CLI as the primary development tool - Key commands for linting (`shopify theme check`), dev server (`shopify theme dev`), and deployment - Authentication requirements (OAuth or `SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN`) - Important gotchas discovered during setup: - `shopify theme check` default output uses a pager — use `--output json` for automation - Theme has ~4600 pre-existing lint offenses (mostly missing translations) - Theme structure overview for quick orientation ## Environment Setup The update script installs Shopify CLI globally: ``` npm install -g @shopify/cli @shopify/theme ``` ## Verification - Node.js v22.22.2 + Shopify CLI 4.8.2 installed and working - `shopify theme check --path . --output json` runs successfully (129 files scanned, 4589 offenses — all pre-existing) - `shopify theme dev` correctly reports auth error when no valid store credentials are provided - Dev server requires `SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN` + `--store` to start (secrets not yet configured)
